name: Golden Goat
summary: **Golden Goat** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] that originated from an unplanned pollination in Topeka, Kansas, [[country:US|USA]], when a [[hawaiian-x-romulan|Hawaiian x Romulan]] male fertilized an [[island-sweet-skunk|Island Sweet Skunk]] female grown by a cultivator known as Mr. Dank. The name refers to nearby recycling machines whose scent mingled with the plant's own. Irie Genetics later released a feminized version, Golden Goat S1.

sources.title: Golden Goat: Topeka's Happy Accident That Became a Cannabis Legend
